proof_body:
by
  intro R A₁ A₂ A₃ A₄ B₁ B₂ B₃ B₄ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ f₁ f₂ f₃ g₁ g₂ g₃ a b c d h1 h2 h3 ef1 ef2 eg1 ha hb hd
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro x hx
  have h4 : f₃ x = 0 := hd (by
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun h3 x
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at this
    rw [map_zero, ← this, hx, map_zero])
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (ef2 x).1 h4
  have h5 : g₂ (b y) = 0 := by
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun h2 y
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at this
    rw [this, hx]
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (eg1 (b y)).1 h5
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := ha z
  have h6 : b (f₁ w) = b y := by
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun h1 w
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at this
    rw [← this, hz]
  have h7 : f₁ w = y := hb h6
  rw [← h7]
  exact (ef1 (f₁ w)).2 ⟨w, rfl⟩
